insight: Cheap identity reset can collapse trust, weaken trustworthiness, and convert reputation worlds into newcomer-suspicion worlds.
Actor identifiability and action visibility are separate disclosure contracts; identity cues can change cooperation even when behavior visibility is held fixed.
recommended_next_build: One leave/rematch or reputation lane with explicit reset rights, newcomer priors, and probation semantics.
One disclosure comparison that separates anonymous visible-action play from identifiable private-action play and from identifiable public-history play.
